brief:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog will announce his choice for prime minister on Sunday, Al Jazeera English reported. The decision follows a vote among lawmakers in which a majority backed Gadi Eisenkot over Benjamin Netanyahu as their preferred candidate to lead the next government.

The announcement represents a significant moment in Israeli politics, as the endorsement by the parliamentary majority signals potential shifts in coalition negotiations ahead of formal government formation.
dek: Announcement comes after majority of Israeli lawmakers endorse Eisenkot over Netanyahu.
title: Herzog to name coalition candidate after lawmakers reject Netanyahu
